validator_design.leader: run_nondet_unsafe evaluates _evaluate_context, which independently retrieves every bound source, verifies status/size/UTF-8 and committed SHA-256 values, parses the immutable program criteria and policy, and asks for one decision.

validator_design.opposite_decision_behavior: A leader CERTIFIED result and validator REJECTED result fail the predicate and cannot reach the Registry callback.
